title: Why 11 Plus 13 Is Always Even
description: Pairing up leftover dots to see why two odd numbers always sum to an even one.
narration_lines: Why does 11 plus 13 come out even, when both numbers are odd?
Take 11 and 13 -- both odd, so each has one dot left over after pairing up.
Those two leftover dots pair up with each other.
No dot left alone, so 11 plus 13 is even -- odd plus odd always is.
